title: Yesuni Roopamloniki Maaraali – Sharon Sisters Telugu Christian Lyrics

credits.Produced: Dr. Ch Solomon Raju & Eliza solmon

intro: Yesuni Roopamloniki Maaraali is the Christian Telugu song from the album, Ashatheera released in 2005 written by Pastor N J Simon and tuned by Bro Philip Gariki, sung by Sharon Sisters, music composed by renowned Telugu christian music director, J K Christopher & M Paramjyoti and produced by Dr. Ch Solomon Raju & Eliza solmon. This song video was released on February 22, 2021 through Philip Sharon YouTube Channel.
